value_status.frozen: value inherited from an existing production source cited in 'source'
value_status.defined_by_c0: no production precedent existed; C0 defines it and validates it against the offline fixture (plan section 3 item 3). Live widening after a failure is not authorized.

frame_semantics.transform_notation: T_a_b maps b coordinates into a coordinates; T_tcp_box is box->TCP
frame_semantics.world_tcp_from_target: T_world_tcp = T_world_box * inverse(T_tcp_box); centre height never re-adds half the box height
frame_semantics.container_opening: container -X side; inward normal +X; generic code reads the inward normal, no world-axis hardcoding
frame_semantics.quaternion_convention: xyzw; q/-q and pi/-pi are representation equivalences and never reject alone; quaternion sign must not encode wrist family
frame_semantics.source: docs/plans/frame_migration_st09_planner_convergence.md section 5.1; attachment_frame_contracts.py reproduce-oracle (1e-9); motion_frame_contracts fk budget ulp rule

joint_limits.joint_wrap_rule: wraps must respect the real limits; never blindly take the nearest 2pi solution

timed_trajectory_start_drift_rad.meaning: max |current_q - trajectory_first_knot_q| before executing a timed joint trajectory; beyond it the executor refuses (wire code QP_START_STATE_MISMATCH, historical name) and the route must be replanned

start_and_fk_gates.fk_threshold_equality: threshold equality passes (a few ulps over the decimal threshold are accepted)

tool_orientation.keep_tool_down_semantics: scores suction tilt against world -Z and ignores yaw (IK may pick the yaw+pi branch)

wrist_singularity_margin_rad.enforcement: diagnostic only; j5/j6 travel and family labels are not refuse gates; refusals come from real continuity, limits, singularity margin of the certified trajectory and collision

tool_orientation.transport_orientation: fixed through narrow/portal segments; certified continuous transitions allowed in clearance zones with accompanying translation

occupancy_inflate_m.meaning: cargo-map occupancy inflation for route clearances

arm_min_margin_m.meaning: hard floor for the measured wrist/elbow clearance on top-K rows

placement_top_clearance_m.meaning: required free space above the placed box

same_layer_clearance_m.meaning: minimum boundary gap between oriented footprints on the same support surface; equality passes; a stacked box is exempt only against its support parent

collision_margins.margin_naming_rule: S1 refines these into separately named static-wall / cargo / support-contact margins with unified sources; C0 freezes the current numbers

time_parameterization.profile: site rest-to-rest trapezoid replaces MoveIt TOTG/linear times; geometric knots are kept
time_parameterization.source: src/luggage_planning/luggage_planning/motion_executor.py:68-69,325-331,404 (apply_rest_to_rest_to_joint_trajectory caps 60 deg/s and 20 deg/s^2); trajectory_selector.py SELECTOR_DEFAULTS

route_total_wall_s.meaning: one route request budget; exhaustion returns PLANNING_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, never BIN_FULL

max_edge_repair_attempts.meaning: including failures; cache hits do not count

certification_timeout_s.meaning: certifier wall-clock budget; timeout fails closed
certification_timeout_s.source: C0 definition consistent with the single-edge 2 s budget

certification_sampling.motion_bound_rule: geometric motion bound <= min(map_resolution/2, smallest_positive_clearance_margin/2), adaptively subdivided; unbounded gaps refuse certification
certification_sampling.support_contact_exemption: landing/support-contact exemption covers the target support contact only; never a whole column or neighbouring placed boxes

cargo_view_join_window_s.meaning: buffered cloud must be within this window of the request stamp to join (STAMP_STALE otherwise)

planning_snapshot_age_max_s.meaning: snapshot acquisition stamp age allowed at route admission; older snapshots re-observe (OBSERVATION_REQUIRED), never plan on stale maps

map_freshness.revision_semantics: revision unchanged does not mean fresh: acquisition time and receiver monotonic time are checked separately; before-send epoch recheck on every controller send

tf_sync_max_skew_ns.meaning: T_tcp_box is computed from the SAME-stamp measured box pose and TCP TF (exact ns equality inherited from require_measured_pose_agreement)

attachment_max_age_ns.meaning: acquisition -> use window for a frozen record at admission; matches the 60 s placement budget so a search inside that budget is not ATTACHMENT_EXPIRED

grasp_binding_tolerance_m.meaning: planned grasp vs measured transform agreement at freeze; also the slip check bound

attachment_policy.slip_check_policy: a re-observed box pose composed through the frozen record must agree with the live TCP within grasp_binding_tolerance_m/rad; beyond it the record invalidates (ATTACHMENT_SLIP), the route fails and the chain enters carry-fault with vacuum retained
attachment_policy.reattach_policy: every confirmed re-attach allocates a new attachment_incarnation; old records and dependent routes invalidate (ATTACHMENT_REATTACH)
attachment_policy.release_verification: release requires the measured final tool pose at/after the attach stamp with time_basis acquisition (admit_release); no unverified detach
attachment_policy.dimension_axis_semantics: dimensions are recorded along the fixed box axes (width/depth/height); never re-sorted by length

symmetry_declaration.rule: theta+pi heading expansion only when the payload model declares pi symmetry; theta and theta+pi are distinct physical rotations, each resolved through the actual attachment

attachment_policy.symmetry_default_source: src/luggage_packing/luggage_packing/placement_solver.py _snap_yaws (footprint symmetric under pi); 5.1 upgrades it to a declared payload property
attachment_policy.source_grade_rules: carried routes require measured_attach_confirmed; pre-attach estimates are initial-selection only; sim GT relative transforms are reference-only and must never register as measured

goal_accept_wait_s.meaning: future/goal acceptance wait; also the cancel acknowledgement deadline

stop_and_cancel_deadlines.stop_policy: in-flight conflicts cancel/controlled-stop, confirm standstill and keep vacuum (carry-fault); recovery is a new admission from the measured settled q, never an automatic retreat target
stop_and_cancel_deadlines.stop_envelope: measured evidence obligation (detection/cancel/stop latency + stop envelope) with fault injection beyond the controllable lead time - S3 item 5 and R; not a config number
